scope: Exploratory algorithmic benchmark, not held-out physical prediction. All trial definitions are emitted before execution.

criteria.exact_regime: Every converged noiseless output matches the independent arithmetic oracle; any mismatch is a mechanism failure.
criteria.diversity: Hash only structural events, excluding seeds, IDs and timestamps; report initial/final diversity separately.
criteria.graded: Report all outcomes, Wilson intervals, censored timeouts and entropies; do not infer a phase transition from a finite curve.
criteria.locality: Expose the global scheduler, enabled-event discovery and termination observer; no claim of fully decentralized calculation.
criteria.higher_order: Compare replay exclusion present/absent under equal attempted replay probability, then a no-fault control.
